Page 05 · I'm sorry

Dil se sorry, Babuu 🥺

Mujhe ehsaas hai ki kuch waqt se humare beech bahut ladai ho rahi hai. Main kabhi-kabhi zyada shak karta hoon aur bina poori baat samjhe tumhe galat samajh leta hoon. Isse tumhe takleef hui ho, toh mujhe sach mein maaf kar dena. Sirf sorry kehna kaafi nahi hota—main apne bartav mein bhi badlav laane ki koshish karunga.
Page 06 · A promise to do better

Behtar banne ki koshish

Main chahta hoon ki hum ek doosre se khulkar baat karein, ek doosre ko samjhein aur bharosa banayein. Main apni feelings ko shaant tareeke se kehna aur tumhari baat dhyan se sunna seekhunga. Tum par koi pressure nahi—bas meri taraf se ek sachchi koshish.

Pyaar ke saath respect aur trust bhi zaroori hain. ❤️

Ek chhota sa promise ⭐
Main baat ko samajhne ki koshish karunga, jaldi react nahi karunga, aur tumhari feelings ko importance dunga. ❤️
